title: Resilient NAT/IGW Router Terraform module with endpoint-aware routing
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Implement a reusable Terraform module that manages VPC routing and egress with automated NAT/IGW failover and endpoint-aware route resolution. The module should provide: (1) idempotent creation of AZ-aware public and private subnets, NAT Gateways with Elastic IP allocation and automatic failover logic, and optional IGW for mixed egress patterns; (2) VPC endpoint configuration for S3, ECR, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager and customer-specific endpoints; (3) routing table generation with priority-based routes, per-subnet next-hop resolution, and explicit route propagation for VPN/Transit Gateway attachments; (4) hooks and lifecycle policies to perform zero-downtime upgrades of route tables and NAT replacements; (5) health-check integration (CloudWatch custom metrics + Lambda reconciler) that can mark unhealthy NATs and trigger automated replacement and route pivoting. Module must be consumable by private (VPC) deployments and support both host-account and cross-account endpoint patterns.
acceptance_criteria: Module creates private/public subnets with deterministic names and tags required by our private deploy templates
Automatic NAT failover: when a NAT gateway reports >90th percentile packet loss or fails health checks, the module triggers replacement and reroutes traffic within 3 minutes
VPC endpoints are created idempotently and route tables prefer endpoints for supported services (S3/ECR) without breaking existing private routes
Upgrade path documented: consumers can update module versions with a canary rollout across one AZ and rollback on failure
Terratest suite covers creation, route propagation, NAT replacement simulation, and endpoint reachability for minimal and full config
Module variables and outputs follow naming conventions and have clear validation and type constraints
tasks: Draft Terraform module interface (inputs/outputs, defaults) and publish design spec in Confluence
Prototype NAT failover lambda + CloudWatch metric emitter and test in sandbox account
Implement Terraform resources: subnets, igw, natgw(s), route tables, vpc endpoints, route attachments
Add lifecycle hooks and pre/post apply warnings for disruptive changes
Write Terratest (Go) and lightweight local acceptance tests using AWS SDK mocks
Create migration guide and roll-out playbook for private customers
Add automated CI checks: tflint, fmt, validate, and terratest in pipeline
Security review and KMS/EIP allocation policy review
comments: 2026-02-20 - Aisha Kaur: Initial ticket created after networking spike. Goal is to reduce operational toil during NAT/IGW upgrades and standardize endpoints across private installs.

2026-02-24 - Diego Ramos: Drafted module interface in doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/NET/Router+Module+Spec. Calling out optional IGW for hybrid workloads and default to NAT-only for fully private clusters.

2026-02-28 - Design review (PM+Infra): recommend adding an explicit 'egress_mode' variable (nat | igw | mixed) and an 'endpoint_preference' list to control route priority. Also noted tagging standards for billing and observability.

2026-03-02 - Diego Ramos: Pushed prototype of health-check lambda to sandbox repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/networking-sandbox/pull/47. Lambda emits custom CloudWatch metric natgw.healthy (0/1) and writes to S3 maintenance log.

2026-03-05 - Security (L. Chen): security review requested. Questions around EIP lifecycle and least privilege for the replacer lambda. Requested plan for KMS usage when storing replacement EIP assignments.

2026-03-07 - Diego Ramos: Addressed security comments in design doc and added KMS envelope encryption for SSM parameter storage. Updated IAM policy to restrict replace-actions to tagged resources only.
2026-03-09 - QA: terratest skeleton added. CI failing on provider version pin; need alignment with aws provider v5.0. Open task to bump module constraints.

2026-03-10 - PM (R. Alvarez): Approved priority and asked for migration playbook for existing Dedicated customers. Suggested a canary pattern: deploy module to one region/AZ pair and monitor latency/cost metrics for 48 hours before full rollout.
decision_log: Decision 2026-02-26: Use per-AZ NAT gateways instead of single centralized proxy to reduce cross-AZ egress charges and to simplify failover semantics.

Decision 2026-03-03: Implement health-checking and automated replacement via a small Lambda reconciler rather than relying solely on Terraform apply to repair state. Chosen to minimize human ops during incidents.
Decision 2026-03-08: Provide 'egress_mode' variable with 'mixed' default to allow customers to opt-in IGW for bursty public egress workloads.
Decision 2026-03-09: Pin aws provider to >=4.60,<6.0 and include migration notes for provider v5; CI will enforce provider constraints
